baseline.base_dataset_scope: v1模板预标注；30,384条/1,899回合，train=24,416；新v8数量必须实测
baseline.baseline_policy: 执行时重新核验，不覆盖历史v1数据、v8人工决定或v4资源接受工件；漂移先定位来源并版本化，不机械接受旧证据。

signatures.corpus_signature: prepare_paired_corpus(records, reviewed_pairs, contract, output_dir) -> report；records通过现有.NET规则链适配器提供，纯模块用fixture独立验证
signatures.weight_signature: build_epoch_entries(train_records, repeat_policy) -> weighted_entries；每个原回合所有副本权重和为1；可复用的sample-mean loss reducer有CPU数值验证
signatures.budget_signature: measure_paired_budget(record_iter, tokenizer_adapter, contract) -> report；tokenizer_adapter注入，独立于G2实现
signatures.readiness_signature: evaluate_preparation_evidence(stage4_report, corpus_report, budget_report, runtime_config, resource_report) -> report；只消费冻结报告结构

records.reviewPair: Full reviewed record plus approved Narrative and reviewVersion, source hashes, evidence IDs; purpose-specific resolver must avoid reading test payloads for train/dev
records.fixturePolicy: Synthetic records follow existing shape. Modules do not import other worker new implementations.

policy.report_shape: schemaVersion, checkId, status, reasonCodes[], evidenceBindings[], details；status为passed/failed/not-tested/not-required；缺失、漂移、未测不能推导ready。
policy.binding_shape: 逻辑路径、SHA-256、源码/Schema/规则/review/tokenizer版本、split、purpose、complete/frozen及检查范围。私有路径只进入私有工件。
policy.corpus_signature: prepare_paired_corpus(records, reviewed_pairs, contract, output_dir) -> report；records通过现有.NET规则链适配器提供，纯模块用fixture独立验证
policy.weight_signature: build_epoch_entries(train_records, repeat_policy) -> weighted_entries；每个原回合所有副本权重和为1；可复用的sample-mean loss reducer有CPU数值验证
policy.budget_signature: measure_paired_budget(record_iter, tokenizer_adapter, contract) -> report；tokenizer_adapter注入，独立于G2实现
policy.readiness_signature: evaluate_preparation_evidence(stage4_report, corpus_report, budget_report, runtime_config, resource_report) -> report；只消费冻结报告结构
policy.test_isolation: 训练/调参消费者只获配train/dev；test由独立用途入口导出/核验/测固定预算，只向主线给出脱敏状态和绑定。真实test内容、目标、长度分布和异常样例不进入子任务prompt或用于配置选择；详细失败证据封存在私有隔离报告。
policy.scope_interpretation: 步骤二的加权loss落地交付独立可复用函数与数值测试，绑定后续trainer必用契约；本轮不创建optimizer、不声称完成训练梯度集成。步骤六/七将验证真实训练路径。
policy.status_semantics: 本轮preparationReady/既有stage6Ready只表示前三步语料与配置准入；trainingExecutionReady保持false，仍须步骤四至七。保留resourceAccepted=true与resourceProbeReady=false；不改旧v4状态。

sharedExistingPolicy: apps/cli、.NET测试登记、现有导出/加载器的必要适配，以及语料/运行新配置和最终报告由主线单独写；精确新增/修改清单在派发前登记到frozen-contract.json。子任务不得并发写这些文件。
resourceScheduling: 小型CPU单测可并行；.NET构建、真实Demo全量导出、大文件哈希/token遍历分别单实例，由主线统一调度，避免重复IO。默认不启动GPU计算、安装依赖或下载。

runtimeProposal.selection_policy: 只在主线核对实际语料和已接受资源证据后冻结新配置；此表是提案，不表示runtime已选。scheduler/warmup、尾批、checkpoint/dev频率、时间/磁盘预算须在本轮独立配置中明确取值和依据；下一步评价协议绑定后才允许后续训练。

testIsolation: 训练/调参消费者只获配train/dev；test由独立用途入口导出/核验/测固定预算，只向主线给出脱敏状态和绑定。真实test内容、目标、长度分布和异常样例不进入子任务prompt或用于配置选择；详细失败证据封存在私有隔离报告。

weightedLossContract.sampleLoss: mean assistant-token loss including EOS; weighted by per-copy round weight
weightedLossContract.accumulation: Use fixed global or predetermined window normalizer, never divide by a single sample weight; no extra multiplier 5

runtimeFinalization: Main freezes exact config after actual counts/train-dev budget; test never feeds selection.
sharedExistingChangesPending: Exact exporter/loader file list will be added before dispatch after source adapter inspection
reportBindingRules: Binding entries contain logicalPath and sha256; file-reading validators must actually rehash through injected resolver. Include report/source/config bindings, not self-referential hashes. Public output removes local absolute paths and raw test details.
bindingLogicalPaths: repo:<repository-relative-posix-path> or storage:<storage-relative-posix-path>; no absolute paths in public bindings
sourceExportInterface: ExportAsync(..., ct, shardIndex=0, shardCount=1); dedicated shard CLI; three independent OS export processes; immutable shard manifests and verified merge
continuationOwnership: G1/G2/G3 completed; main maintains integration and final corrections after child sessions ended

userSchedulingOverride.instruction: 并发三个程序并行导出
userSchedulingOverride.assignment: Within each frozen split: Demo bytes descending, MatchId ordinal tie break, greedy lowest byte total with worker-index tie break. Merge exact disjoint/exhaustive 71/8/8 membership and byte readback before completion.
userSchedulingOverride.previousRuns: r1/r2 incomplete artifacts retained; r2 own export/supervisor stopped after PID and creation-time verification
userSchedulingOverride.precedence: Explicit user instruction supersedes draft single-export resource scheduling only.
